blocks.text:
After breakfast, you will visit one of Rio’s main landmarks: the statue of Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado.

From the station, the train climbs through dense forest to the 38-metre statue. Unveiled in 1931, the monument has become one of Brazil’s most recognisable images. From the viewing platform, almost the whole city comes into view: the ocean, beaches, bays, mountains and Rio’s neighbourhoods form one sweeping panorama.

After the tour, return to the hotel and relax.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, travel to Praia Vermelha, or Red Beach, where the cable car ascent begins. The first stop is Urca Hill. Here you can spend time on the viewing platform, have a coffee and look out over the bay from above.

The cable car then continues up to Sugar Loaf. From the summit, you can see Copacabana and Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge and Corcovado with the statue of Christ.

After the descent, the journey continues through the city. You will see the architecture of the central districts. Time permitting, you may visit the Metropolitan Cathedral of São Sebastião and stop for photographs at the colourful Selarón Steps.

Return to the hotel.
